observations.title: Vendored MHFE retains the separately recorded overlapping self-check API risk
observations.reproduction: Inspect the exact 2a1caf4b runtime PackageCheck.require against MHFE AUD-014: sticky failure is checked before, but not after, awaiting startup. The MHFE report retains public API witnesses.
observations.expected: The MHFE package promises that a failed check permanently closes subsequent and pending operations.
observations.observed: The vendor contains the same pre-await-only gate. Normal Deriver panel jobs are serialized; Generate & Derive checked mode has a separate engine, and global failure disables/cancels generation and publication. No normal Deriver UI overlap bypass was demonstrated.
observations.impact: Inherited library API concern, not a new bit-slicing/sampling defect or demonstrated Deriver UI key-generation bypass. Its primary severity and release decision remain in the MHFE report; this targeted Deriver audit does not certify the whole release.
evidence: review of RecoveryJobGate, MhfeTask, CheckedMnemonicFeature and controller failure/publication gates
observations.recommendedFix: Resolve MHFE AUD-014-SEC001 in its authoritative source, then explicitly sync the rebuilt vendor and rerun package/UI gates. No vendor sync was authorized or performed here.
observations.requiredVerification: Primary MHFE public API race regressions and the Deriver's relevant checked-generation/startup failure cases must pass on the exact synced bytes.

observations.title: Excluded-word bit expectation corrected in the statistical tests
observations.reproduction: Under the ideal uniform-word model, exclude zoo (index 2047, all eleven bits set) and enumerate the 2047 remaining indices: each bit has 1023 ones.
observations.expected: The per-bit null is 1023/2047, not 0.5; joint and grouped-bin nulls likewise count the actual allowed indices.
observations.observed: Baseline c312d494 test assumed 0.5. Authorized additions derive the allowed-list null and enumeration reproduces 0.49975574010747437 for every bit. All 47 scoped tests pass.
observations.impact: Confirmed small test-model error, not a production generator defect. At 20,000 phrases the shift is about 0.069 standard deviations, with no practical baseline false-positive or false-negative demonstrated. SHA/checksum modeling remains idealized.
observations.recommendedFix: Completed in the authorized test-only change; retain enumerated null controls without claiming exact entropy or suite-wide significance.
observations.requiredVerification: The allowed-index enumeration, five-length production datasets and checksum-valid poison controls pass on the bound source.

testImprovements: Whole-integer/Node-SHA public API oracle: 696,320 nonfinal cases, 20,480 final-index acceptance/refusal cases and 992 suffix preimages; all five lengths, exact full phrase and neighbors compared.

Startup: 2,340 writer comparisons plus 2,340 reader comparisons from separate oracle fixtures; 90 positions, 13 patterns, two backgrounds, five independently pinned checksum answers and true/false predicate/plan controls.
Existing exact 24-word startup phrase retained; real checksum faults, complete wrong phrases and in-memory implementation mutants challenge refusal rather than round trips alone.

Statistical coverage expanded: 17 production datasets containing 149,152 phrases across all five lengths, plus 360,000 synthetic checksum-valid controls. Per-position, selected bit-joint/correlation, exclusion and anywhere multiplicity models added.
limitations: No newly confirmed mapping/sampling defect; passing tests do not prove absence of arbitrary defects, RNG entropy or host-compromise resistance.

Statistical fixtures use finite fixed-seed samples and ideal SHA/checksum modeling. Wilson-Hilferty chi-square bounds are explicitly approximate, per comparison, not exact multinomial or suite-wide failure rates.
Independent application oracles still trust the pinned English wordlist and cryptographic primitives after public KAT checks; no new cryptographic primitive certification.
Full card generation, full browser self-test button, full-cost Argon2/vectors, complete test matrix, Docker reproducibility and release acceptance were not executed.
Full project check fails on the historical AUD-024 missing link; those audit bytes are not silently rewritten. Direct source typechecking passes.

Original artifact harness assumed the deliberately unvendored native launcher was present; its failure and corrected owner-based inventory probe are both retained, not counted as an application defect.
Original TS7 parser harness error and new typed-array test annotation failure are retained separately; corrected checks pass and are not baseline application findings.

Early process-group sampling excludes detached children; later descendant monitoring addresses that gap but still samples, can miss immediately reparented/short-lived processes, omits swaps/cache and may count shared pages twice. Neither is a hard allocation cap or earlier-freeze diagnosis.

The audit memory helper stops sampling during its bounded exit cleanup, lacks external-termination cleanup, and requires Linux procfs/Python pidfd support. Its synthetic probes exercise basic ownership/exit behavior, not every resource-failure path; no safety termination occurred in application tests.

Existing provenance verification queried public GitHub commit availability; two queries returned HTTP 422 and local uncommitted vendors remain explicitly warned. No secret values were transmitted, no application network behavior was added, and no signed-release provenance claim is made.
The report completion date and timestamps use UTC.

Coordinator model/effort telemetry unavailable; requested GPT6.1 ultra and three explicitly configured gpt-6.1-sol ultra reviewers are distinguished. No commit, push, vendor sync or other checkout was created.
